summary.en-US: Keep selected tabs active and control the browser events pages use to detect inactivity.

description.en-US: Always Active Plus keeps pages active by controlling the visibility, focus, mouse, pointer, and configurable keyboard events exposed to those pages. It runs on all sites by default; the hostname list provides exceptions. An optional included-sites mode runs only on listed hostnames. Mouse re-entry movement can be interpolated with adjustable speed and start and stop smoothness. Settings remain in local extension storage, and the extension does not collect or transmit user data.

version.approval_notes: The extension contains readable, unminified JavaScript with no bundling, generated code, remote code, or third-party libraries. The v3 directory is the exact extension source. It stores preferences locally with chrome.storage.local and does not collect or transmit user data. The broad host permission supports the default all-sites mode; users can configure hostname exceptions or switch to an included-sites mode. Build with: npx --yes web-ext@10.5.0 build --source-dir v3
